_comment: Example for `agent-network-mcp ui --runners runners.json`: three Qwen Code agents on a project in git, one worktree each.
Copy it (e.g. to agent-network-mcp/runners.json, which is gitignored) and replace every /abs/path with your paths.
Worktrees: cd /abs/path/project && git worktree add ../project-backend -b swarm-backend && git worktree add ../project-reviewer -b swarm-reviewer && git worktree add ../project-tester -b swarm-tester
networkDir is shared by all agents; relative paths here (promptFile) are resolved against this file's folder.
qwen does not expand ${AGENT_ID} in --mcp-config but passes its environment to MCP servers: the runner sets AGENT_ID and NETWORK_DIR.
Prompt first, right after qwen: --allowed-tools takes several values and would swallow it.
autostart: false = start that agent with the button on the page.
